neighbours.label: '-form' in hyphenated -forming compounds (habit-forming, rock-forming, blood-forming, coil-forming), as opposed to the same nouns with other adjectives and to 'form' as a noun
fire: Nicotine is a highly habit-forming drug.
Quartz is a common rock-forming mineral.
The marrow holds the blood-forming stem cells.
Some opinion-forming papers backed the plan.
The gel-forming step takes an hour.
Cloud-forming particles rise from the ocean.
quiet: Nicotine is a highly addictive drug.
Quartz is a common white mineral.
The marrow holds the red stem cells.
Some local papers backed the plan.
He filled in the form and left it.
The first step takes an hour.
Tiny particles rise from the ocean.
